#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bookshelf manipulation driver for the eai-standard/2.1 robot service.

Each named motion is a short, observable servo chunk. Run this file with a pose
name and step count; it reconnects to the same running service episode.
"""
import json, os, sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
CAMERAS = ["left_eye_camera", "right_eye_camera", "room_camera"]

def normalized_action(spec, body_q, hand_mode="open", arm_overrides=None):
    ranges = np.asarray(spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"], dtype=float)
    q = np.zeros(61, dtype=float)
    q[:21] = body_q[:21]
    if arm_overrides:
        for name, value in arm_overrides.items():
            q[spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"].index(name)] = value
    # Hands use zero-radian targets for an open, neutral posture; closing flexes
    # the finger joints and their coupled tendon actuators toward their upper limits.
    if hand_mode == "closed":
        for idx in range(21, 61):
            name = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"][idx]
            if "WRJ" not in name:
                q[idx] = ranges[idx, 1]
    mid = ranges.mean(axis=1)
    half = (ranges[:, 1] - ranges[:, 0]) / 2
    return np.clip((q - mid) / half, -1, 1).astype(np.float32)

def observe(r, tag):
    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video="none")
    steps = obs.meta.get("control_steps", 0)
    for name, frame in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(np.asarray(frame, dtype=np.uint8)).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{tag}_{steps}_{name}.png"))
    print(json.dumps({"status": r.status(), "obs_meta": obs.meta}, default=str))

def main():
    pose = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "observe"
    steps = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 20
    grip = sys.argv[3] if len(sys.argv) > 3 else "open"
    r = Robot()
    spec = r.spec()
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "spec.json"), "w") as f: json.dump(spec, f, indent=2)
    if pose == "observe":
        observe(r, "obs")
        return
    prior = r.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, video="none")
    now = np.asarray(prior.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    body_q = now[:21].copy()
    # The action layout groups the right arm at 16..20; proprioception groups it
    # after the left hand, at 40..44.
    body_q[16:21] = now[40:45]
    overrides = {}
    if pose == "reach_pale":
        # Right arm rises and moves slightly toward the center of the shelf.
        overrides = {"right_shoulder_pitch": -0.55,
                     "right_shoulder_roll": 0.20,
                     "right_shoulder_yaw": 0.0,
                     "right_elbow": -0.85,
                     "right_wrist_yaw": 0.0}
    elif pose == "reach_higher":
        overrides = {"right_shoulder_pitch": -0.85,
                     "right_shoulder_roll": 0.18,
                     "right_shoulder_yaw": 0.0,
                     "right_elbow": -1.10,
                     "right_wrist_yaw": 0.0}
    elif pose == "reach_left":
        overrides = {"left_shoulder_pitch": -0.65,
                     "left_shoulder_roll": -0.15,
                     "left_shoulder_yaw": 0.0,
                     "left_elbow": -0.85,
                     "left_wrist_yaw": 0.0}
    elif pose == "base":
        pass
    else:
        raise SystemExit(f"unknown pose: {pose}")
    action = normalized_action(spec, body_q, grip, overrides)
    res = r.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(action[None, :], steps, axis=0),
                   dt=0.02, interpolate="linear", cameras=CAMERAS, video="none",
                   note=f"bookshelf_simple {pose} {grip}")
    n = res.meta.get("control_steps", 0)
    for name, frame in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(np.asarray(frame, dtype=np.uint8)).save(os.path.join(OUT, f"{pose}_{n}_{name}.png"))
    print(json.dumps({"meta": res.meta, "status": r.status()}, default=str))

if __name__ == "__main__": main()
